title: Skeleton
body:
The Skeleton is an enemy appearing during a Blood Moon during the Halloween 2024 event. When killed, it drops 1-3 Bone, 1-3 Candycorn, and has a 20-40% chance to drop a Skull. There is also a chance for it to spawn with a Linked Sword in its hand, dropping it with an 90% chance after death.

The Skeleton can spawn in the center of the Farlands (near the Lighthouse), the Taiga (behind Alan's Autologistics) and in the Savannah.

The Skeleton can also spawn very commonly in the Acidlands biome. They have a chance to spawn holding a Dragonbone sword, which can be dropped. The Skeleton has 3 variants - Skeleton - Skeleton Knight - Skeleton Bomber
